errors.evidence: The description states there are eight category labels on the horizontal axis, but the chart clearly shows nine: “程度”, “空间”, “时间”, “形态”, “频数”, “情绪”, “状态”, “评价”, and “性格”.

The description claims the categories are arranged in "Chinese character order", but they are not sorted by any discernible standard such as Pinyin alphabetical order or stroke count. The subsequent phrase "no specific sorting" is correct, but the initial claim is inaccurate.
